Done. I've implemented all three functions and updated CHANGELOG.md:

1. **clamp(n, min, max)** — uses Math.min/Math.max to constrain n within [min, max]
2. **formatBytes(n)** — divides by 1024 repeatedly, selecting B/KB/MB/GB, formatted to one decimal place
3. **slugify(title)** — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, removes non-alphanumeric characters except dashes

Each is exported from its module.
